point: the Fed is done hiking this cycle

reasons.text: the December dots dropped the last projected hike

source_excerpt: The Committee emphasized that it will need to see more consistent evidence of sustained inflation decline before considering adjustments to the policy stance. The median projection for the federal funds rate at the end of 2026 is 4.75 percent, implying two 25bp cuts from current levels.

sides.claim: first cut in Q3 2026 as labor cools

reasons.text: job gains slowed from 250k to 180k monthly

sides.claim: cuts wait until late 2026 unless the labor market cracks

reasons.text: downside risks to the labor market could warrant easing in the latter half

source_excerpt: Our base case calls for the first cut in Q3 2026, driven by a gradual cooling in labor market conditions. Several members noted that downside risks to the labor market could warrant policy easing in the latter half of the year.
